name: Triple Osc Poly Styles
author: Freek van Gool
description: Tunes for Triple Osc Poly by music style: trance, house, pop, synthwave, ambient, cinematic, future bass, funk, disco, electro, techno and lo-fi. Pads, strings, leads, chords, stabs, arps, keys and basses. Pads and strings need notes of at least half a second; stabs, plucks and arps are for short notes.
